# CONF-007: Origin header is validated on Streamable HTTP

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, http | [2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#security--endpoint](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#security--endpoint) |

Sends a valid request with Origin: https://mcpprobe-rebind.invalid. Servers MUST validate Origin to prevent DNS rebinding and MUST answer an invalid Origin with HTTP 403; the rule is the same in 2025-11-25 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports#security-warning). On servers that speak both eras it runs twice: once with modern requests, and once inside a legacy initialize session as <ID>@legacy.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-007`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-007"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
